links.comparator_used: Ungrounded model (C1, no retrieved graph context); also compared knowledge-graph (C2), causal-graph (C3) and integrated (C4) grounding conditions
links.outcome: Causal edge F1, adverse-effect F1, evidence accuracy, unsupported claim rate, and raw intervention accuracy
links.effect: Integrated grounding C4: causal edge F1 0.838, adverse-effect F1 0.833, evidence accuracy 0.738, unsupported claim rate 0.114; ungrounded C1: highest raw intervention accuracy 0.948 with no measurable causal or evidential grounding
links.tradeoff: Ungrounded C1 had the highest raw intervention accuracy (0.948), so graph grounding did not improve single-answer accuracy.
links.quote: The metric panel discriminates conditions along interpretable, non-redundant axes: C4 obtains the strongest causal edge F1 (0.838), adverse-effect F1 (0.833), evidence accuracy (0.738), and unsupported claim rate (0.114), while C1 obtains the highest raw intervention accuracy (0.948) with no measurable causal or evidential grounding.

design_hint: retrieval grounding with causal knowledge graph
